identity.title: Stabilize Runtime conversation cleanup-race admission and deadline semantics

values.goal: Make cleanup-race admission and execution deadlines deterministic so the required Runtime lane and PR #242 can proceed.
values.required_outcome: The proof queues re-authentication and duplicate attachment in server order, observes the existing in-flight turn before its deadline, and receives exactly one terminal result without changing production behavior.
declared_scope: cleanup-race client-frame ordering in the regression test
existing in-flight attachment and exactly-once terminal proof
authority_boundary: Only the existing Runtime conversation owner admits and executes turns.
Authentication and token rotation semantics remain unchanged.
The follow-on does not alter #237 capability authority.
operator_constraints: Use typed C-SDLC v2 lifecycle owners and an issue-bound FastWork worktree.
Run only focused repeated proof and the required Runtime lane.
